title: The CDF 1 − e⁻²ˣ
caption: P(1 < X ≤ 2) = F(2) − F(1) = e⁻² − e⁻⁴ = 0.117: the rise of the curve between x = 1 and 2. The median solves F(m) = 0.5, m = ln 2 / 2 ≈ 0.347.
alt: Graph of F(x) = 1 − e⁻²ˣ rising from 0 towards 1, with points F(1) = 0.8647, F(2) = 0.9817 and the median at height 0.5.
description: F(x) climbs from 0 and approaches 1 but never reaches it.
F(1) = 0.8647 and F(2) = 0.9817; the probability of landing in (1, 2] is the difference, 0.117.
F reaches 0.5 at x = ln 2 / 2 ≈ 0.347, the median.
